meta.bt_team: Team rows tested on every game 2019 to 2026, each judged only on games before it: teams 8-2+ ATS in their last 10 went 248-249 (-4.6%); 15-5+ in their last 20 21-32 (-24.8%); 70%+ in today's role 31-40 (-16.5%); 2-8 or worse 261-226 (+2.1%) the next game at closing prices. Team ATS streaks are noise against the closing line.
meta.bt: Tested out of sample (2021 to 2026, each season judged only on trends from the seasons before it): every side with a spot covering 5+ points above what its closing price implied (55%+ at -110) on 50+ games went 1,054-1,035 (50.4%, -4.2% return) against the closing line; 8+ points (58%+) on 100+ games, 288-285 (50.3%, -5.1% return); the first line alone, 345-345 (50.0%, -4.6% return). Totals the same way: 930-926 (50.1%, -4.4% return). Graded at each game's closing price: these trends have not beaten the closing line on games they never saw. Context, not a pick.
meta.bt_short: League row out of sample (2021 to 2026, each season judged on the two seasons before it): sides whose spot ran 55%+ (5+ points over the price) on 50+ games went 345-345 (50.0%, -4.6% return), lost against the closing line.
meta.bt_held: None of the 30 spots the rule bet made money in 3+ later seasons with p < .05.
